levels.label: STRETCH
levels.method: Maximum of upper Bollinger band and resistance plus Wilder ATR14

levels.label: RESISTANCE
levels.method: Nearest confirmed close pivot above last; otherwise trailing 20-session high

levels.label: SMA 20
levels.method: Arithmetic mean of the latest 20 completed closes

levels.label: SUPPORT
levels.method: Nearest confirmed close pivot below last; otherwise trailing 20-session low

levels.label: DOWN
levels.method: Minimum of lower Bollinger band and support minus ATR14, with positive-price floor

assumptions: Resample overlapping 5-session blocks with replacement from 125 observed log returns; preserve within-block ordering.
Historical return distribution is assumed locally reusable; structural breaks and unseen jumps are not modeled.
No volatility scaling from option IV, option valuation, transaction costs, dividends during projection, or directional probability calibration.
SplitMix64 deterministic seed; displayed paths and particles are stratified by terminal rank and retain their originating trial IDs.
Projection dates are supplied by the caller's exchange calendar; pointwise quantile curves are illustrative conditional scenarios.

caveats: Research conditions are impersonal observations, not personalized advice, executable arbitrage, or a finding of fair value.
Monte Carlo trials and pointwise quantile curves are uncalibrated conditional simulations, not forecasts or validated event probabilities.
The last price is a completed daily close. Daily/EOD research freshness is independent of screen animation or browser refresh.
KNIFE/SPIKE are custom five-session momentum states: |ROC| > 3%, same-direction daily velocity > 0.5%, and same-direction acceleration. Other rising/falling states use ±0.5% ROC.
ZigZag uses a 3% close-price reversal. A pivot is available only at confirmed_at; the final leg remains provisional.
Sector defensive/offensive labels mean benchmark five-session return below −0.5% or above +0.5%; they do not infer institutional flow.

items.text: The close is 100.25, between support 99.05 and resistance 104.85. A future completed close above 104.85 would leave this range on the upside; below 99.05 would leave it on the downside. The outer stretch/down references are 112.20 and 96.75.
Price is 5.63% below its 20-session average (106.23). RSI14 is 22.1, below the commonly watched 30 threshold.
The latest session's decline accelerated. Daily log-return velocity is -1.12%, changing -0.15 percentage points from the prior session. The five-session momentum state is KNIFE.
30-day ATM implied volatility is 33.51%, up 1.07 percentage points over five sessions. Compare this change with the observed price move and volume.
Latest volume is 1.23 times its 20-session average: activity is at or above the recent baseline.
Illustrative sector (DEMO.B) returned +0.88% over five sessions; DEMO returned -4.00%, a difference of -4.88 percentage points. Benchmark state: offensive.

Across 5000 trials built from historical 5-session return blocks, the median terminal price is 101.20. The middle half of simulated endpoints lies between 98.51 and 103.16; the particle cloud shows their distribution.

The reference paths reuse historical return blocks. They are independent of whether price later crosses support or resistance, and current option IV does not change these paths. Investigating a pricing discrepancy next requires an instrument-specific valuation and execution-cost comparison.
